reviewRecord.storage: datasets/coach-review/reviews/<reviewId>.json — append-only; one file per review; never edited in place
reviewRecord.reviewIdRule: `${queueItemId}.${coachId}`; one review per coach per queue item
reviewRecord.amendments: datasets/coach-review/amendments/<reviewId>.r<N>.json — append-only full-replacement records; the base review file is NEVER overwritten
reviewRecord.adjudication: datasets/coach-review/adjudications/<queueItemId>.json — separate append-only record; disagreement preserved, never averaged away

qualityScale.status: engineering draft — pending expert validation, will be revised by coaches

anchors.1: Fundamental breakdown: multiple severe faults; the stroke does not accomplish its tactical job.
anchors.2: Major fault(s) materially limit the stroke's outcome or repeatability.
anchors.3: Functional: identifiable faults, but the stroke accomplishes its job in this context.
anchors.4: Strong mechanics: minor refinements only; repeatable under this context's pressure.
anchors.5: Model form for this context: could be used as a teaching example.

severityScale.1: minor — visible but unlikely to change the outcome of this ball
severityScale.2: moderate — costs quality/consistency in this context
severityScale.3: major — primary reason this stroke fails or breaks down under pressure

confidenceSemantics: coach's own 0..1 confidence in this review; not a model output
cannotEvaluateSemantics: first-class outcome: honest refusal with reason; quality/faults may be empty
